$description: Configuration tokens: knobs that are neither a raw value nor a role. A theme or a site sets them to change geometry and rhythm without touching ramps or roles. Kept deliberately small; a conf token exists only when something reads it.

scale.$description: Multiplier applied to every ref radius. Corporate sets 0, Playful 1.5.

base.$description: Open and close of overlays and panels.

width.$description: The five measures the Container element offers. Sections pick one.
